_material_established_live: 2026-09-19: Material, MD_SURFACE / BLEND_TRANSLUCENT / MSM_DEFAULT_LIT, two_sided False (renders from above; underwater view is a known blockout limit).
_placement: plane pivot at centre; Z = level_m converted to world cm via the landscape datum in research/brief4/input/alpine_8k_height_4x.json z_mapping (world_z_cm = height_m * 100; do NOT add landscape location z, it is already the midpoint offset), NEVER a centred formula. The VISIBLE shoreline is the terrain contour at level Z (terrain above Z occludes the plane) — with static meshes the shoreline shape is the fill-to-level contour, not an authored spline (§0 premise).
_placement_MUST_clip_to_connected_compon: MEASURED 2026-09-19 (shoreline preview): a plane sized to the hydro BBOX over-floods, because the bbox contains sub-level terrain outside the lake. D@590.9 reads 98.7 ha over its bbox vs the true connected basin 49.6 ha (2x) — the bbox includes the cascade descent below 590.9. A@180 reads 134.8 vs 125.5; B@140 matches (13.6, tight bbox). SO T2/T3 must size/shape each water surface to the CONNECTED COMPONENT at the level (flood-fill from centroid, = hydro level_slice(lake_id)), not the bbox. A rectangular plane over the connected component's TIGHT extent still shows corner strays where terrain<Z; measure the stray fraction per lake and, if material, use a component-shaped mesh rather than a plane. Positive control: connected-component areas reproduce hydro EXACTLY (A 125.5, B 13.6, D 49.6 ha). Evidence: _verify/brief4/shoreline_preview_2026-09-19/.

north_cascade._what: D (~592 m) -> tarn B (~140 m): 394 m over ~2 km through 8 pools of 2-10 m; every lip a fall BY CONSTRUCTION. This is the HERO aerial-readability landmark (RULING §7 #6), superseding the §3 three-step stair.

waterfalls._policy: RULING §3 + §7: (1) BY CONSTRUCTION — every north-cascade lip. (2) BY COUPLING — inflow falls for A and B ONLY: candidates within ~500 m upslope of the adopted shoreline WITH elevation ABOVE the adopted surface. The elevation test is MANDATORY — a candidate submerged at the level is filtered out (e.g. (1642,711) drop 18.9 m sits at 157 m, under A@180).
waterfalls._superseded_hero: the §3 three-step stair at (1276,1272)/(1288,1281)/(1295,1288) reverts to an ordinary candidate within the cap (RULING §7 #6).
waterfalls._render_note: the static-mesh approach has no native waterfall. Blockout places falls as DATA plus minimal vertical M_SideWater plane placeholders at each lip; proper cascade FX (Niagara / WaterAdvanced) is deferred to a fidelity pass (BACKLOG). The hero cascade's aerial READABILITY at blockout comes from the stepped pool planes + placeholder fall planes, not FX.

no_town_lip_notch: tarn B is ENDORHEIC (RULING §7 #5): NO cut at the lip (913,1899); the Option II 17 m notch is STRUCK. The south river is only the reach BELOW the lip (south-reach pools 14451, 14393, 14369), fed by its own catchment. The lakes are fill-to-level of existing terrain — no carve creates their depth; only the north-cascade pool-lip notches are cut (T3).
